# Fix power steering clamp leaks

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Fix power steering clamp leaks by tightening an existing wire clamp or replacing it with a wide screw clamp. [t2289]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Tighten the existing wire clamp at the bottom of the reservoir.
2. [Partial] If tightening cuts into the hose, replace with a wide screw clamp.

_Procedure reported by [t2289]._

## Parts

- [Partial] Wire Clamp: Standard or wide screw type [t2289]

## Tips & gotchas

- Old wire clamps cut into the hose over time, loosening the seal on the barb. [t2289]
- Wide screw clamps prevent further cutting of the hose. [t2289]
